# nvme-offload

Safely offload completed Downloads items and video files larger than 500 MB from approved Mac folders to the Samin Razer NVME, verify transfers, inspect logs, or troubleshoot the mount-aware automation. Use when the user asks to free Mac storage with the NVMe, move large videos or Downloads to the external drive, run the NVMe offload, or check whether automatic offloading worked.

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$nvme-offload`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
